workloads.name: effects_opaque_large
workloads.description: Paint of busy content with one opaque 600 x 400 panel over it
workloads.exercises: the baseline: covering the same pixels with an opaque fill

workloads.name: effects_translucent_large
workloads.description: The same panel translucent, with no filter
workloads.exercises: alpha blending over busy content; the equivalent work without an effect

workloads.name: effects_translucent_small
workloads.description: A translucent 200 x 150 panel with no filter
workloads.exercises: the baseline for the small backdrop-filter panel

workloads.name: effects_backdrop_blur_8_small
workloads.description: A translucent 200 x 150 panel with backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
workloads.exercises: sampling and blurring the content behind a small area

workloads.name: effects_backdrop_blur_8_large
workloads.description: A translucent 600 x 400 panel with backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
workloads.exercises: the same blur over a larger area

workloads.name: effects_backdrop_blur_24_large
workloads.description: A translucent 600 x 400 panel with backdrop-filter: blur(24px)
workloads.exercises: a larger blur radius over the same area

workloads.name: effects_translucent_overlap3
workloads.description: Three overlapping translucent 320 x 240 panels with no filter
workloads.exercises: the baseline for overlapping backdrop-filter panels

workloads.name: effects_backdrop_blur_8_overlap3
workloads.description: Three overlapping translucent panels, each with backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
workloads.exercises: each panel blurs the content and the panels beneath it

workloads.name: effects_translucent_large_dpr2
workloads.description: The translucent 600 x 400 panel at a display scale of 2
workloads.exercises: the baseline at 1600 x 1200 physical pixels

workloads.name: effects_backdrop_blur_8_large_dpr2
workloads.description: The 600 x 400 backdrop-filter: blur(8px) panel at a display scale of 2
workloads.exercises: four times the pixels for the same effect

workloads.name: effects_filter_blur_8
workloads.description: A translucent 600 x 400 panel and its content with filter: blur(8px)
workloads.exercises: an element rendered to an intermediate surface and blurred

workloads.name: effects_filter_chain
workloads.description: The same panel with filter: brightness() contrast() saturate()
workloads.exercises: an ordered chain of color filters on an intermediate surface
